amenitiesDescription:
Casa Bella by B&B Italia spans two full amenity floors plus a signature rooftop: the pool deck features Enzo Enea-designed Italian gardens, an 80-foot lap pool, spa, poolside bar and Mediterranean café, private cabanas, open-air yoga lawn, and pickleball court.

Indoor amenities include a fitness center, yoga studios, spa and beauty salon, wine cellar, private theater, game room, children's playroom, and co-working lounge. The 56th-floor Sky Pool Terrace sits nearly 650 feet up with a rooftop pool, panoramic private observatory, and Casa Bella lounge.

Services include 24-hour concierge, valet, and security, on-demand housekeeping and lifestyle services, and a complimentary one-year membership to the Grand Bay Beach Club in Key Biscayne.
architectQuote: The interior is conceived as a single continuous space — you feel the sequence, not the rooms.
description: B&B Italia's first residential tower, now delivered in Miami's Arts District. 56 stories, Piero Lissoni interiors, Related Group and Alta Developers. Closings underway with final homes remaining.

investmentThesis: Officially delivered October 2026 with closings underway and roughly 98% sold: one of the most absorbed new towers in the current Miami cycle. The B&B Italia collaboration is unique in global residential development: Lissoni's design authority extends from lobbies and amenities through every unit interior. On Biscayne Boulevard in the Arts & Entertainment District.
name: Casa Bella by B&B Italia
rentalPolicy: Up to 6–12x per year; 30-day minimum stay
residenceContent: The first development in the world created in collaboration with B&B Italia, the four-time Compasso d'Oro-winning Italian design house. The undulating tower, its curved balconies drawn from the movement of Biscayne Bay, delivers interiors personally designed by Piero Lissoni. Every home features 10-foot ceilings, two private biometric elevators per unit, floor-to-ceiling glass, European porcelain tile, and terraces averaging 196 square feet. Kitchens are finished with Italian cabinetry, Bosch appliance suites, and quartz countertops; bathrooms with floor-to-ceiling porcelain, frameless glass showers, and rain showerheads. Located in the Arts & Entertainment District, minutes from Wynwood, the Design District, Pérez Art Museum, and Frost Science Museum.

hoa.source: MLS active listings, Aug 2026 — monthly association fee ÷ interior sq ft (SqFt LA), median. $1.00/sf across 9 active listings, range $0.61-$1.09; one listing at $0.55/sf excluded as an outlier and twelve showing a $0 or blank fee dropped as data errors. Prior value of $0.80 was the low end of an unsourced range and ran 26% below observed.
